bullets.title: Artichoke tea
bullets.note:
Don’t be thrown off by the name. I drink it cold, and it is surprisingly
similar in taste to Japanese roasted barley tea (mugicha). I typically prepare
this tea by taking two heads, cleaning them, and then low boiling for 15
minutes. Once that’s done, turn off the heat and let it steep for 20 minutes.
Next, remove the heads, mix the liquid with an equal amount of water, and toss
it all in the fridge. Super simple and really refreshing in the morning.
